author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅಭ್ಯಸಿಸು ಅಳವಡಿಸು ಅನುಸರಿಸು ಸತ್ಯವನೆ
ಸಭ್ಯತೆಯ ಎಲ್ಲೆಯನು ಮೀರದಿರು ನೀನು
ಲಭ್ಯವಿಹ ದಾರಿಯಲೆ ಶುಭ್ರತೆಯ ನಡೆನುಡಿಯ
ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡಿ ಪಡೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Study truth, take it in, and follow it;
never cross the bounds of decency;
on the road that lies before you, make pure words and deeds
a habit through practice, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Truth has to be learned, absorbed and lived. Stay within the bounds of decency, and make clean speech and conduct a habit through steady practice.
